capabilities: Track prioritized next steps with drag-and-drop reordering
Snooze or complete steps from a dashboard view
Write letters sealed for delivery on a future date
Save fuzzy-searchable lessons for future reference
Open the dashboard in a sidebar tab
extras: Still under community-store review; README offers a BRAT install path and manual release copy in the meantime. Changelog documents careful handling of note frontmatter to avoid corrupting other fields.
motivation: The author wrote it to keep himself on track, structuring it around how he thinks: next steps, future letters, and lessons.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that surfaces your next actions, future-dated reminders, and lessons learned together in one place.
summary: Personal dashboard plugin that tracks prioritized next steps, delivers sealed letters to your future self on a set date, and keeps searchable lessons learned.
